records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:133 — Returning true when a date override exists bypasses the busy.every(...) conflict check, reporting availability during existing bookings or calendar conflicts.
records.rationale: Looking at lines 127-133 in the diff, after checking date overrides, if `dateOverrideExist` is true (meaning a date override was found for that day but the slot wasn't rejected), the code returns `true` immediately at line 132: `if (dateOverrideExist) { return true; }`. This bypasses the busy-calendar check that happens later in the `busy.every()` loop (lines 153+). This means when a date override exists and the slot is within the override time range, the function returns available without checking if there are conflicting calendar events or existing bookings in the `busy` array.
